verdict.rationale: Customer.io's docs say users can set up recurring tasks that its AI agent runs automatically on a schedule, such as deliverability reports and segment audits. The pricing page lists 'Daily Routines (scheduled tasks)', so this is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Broadcasts sent 'at a time you specify' are one-off scheduling and are not credited as recurring. Missing for 10: details on schedule cadence and configuration (e.g. non-daily intervals, cron-style control), evidence that messaging automations or workflows themselves can run on a recurring time schedule, API/CLI/MCP control of schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.
